title: Mail & Calendar accounts
subtitle: Connect mailboxes and calendars through provider plugins. Agents can read and draft; nothing is sent without your approval.

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Add an account to let agents read your mail and calendar.
empty.noProviderDescription: Install a mail or calendar provider plugin first, then add an account here.

modal.title: Add account
modal.label: Name
modal.secretsHint: Passwords and tokens are never stored here; they go in the vault.
modal.netTcpHint: Add these lines to permissions.net_tcp of the plugin you install:

errors.calendarUrl: The calendar address must start with https://.
errors.imapRequired: Server names and your address are required.
errors.port: Ports must be numbers from 1 to 65535.

modal.verified: Verified against ABI 1: this exact build passed the conformance checks.
modal.unverified: Not verified: no conformance certificate matches this build. It still runs in the same sandbox and behind the same approvals.

confirmDelete.title: Remove this account?
confirmDelete.description: Remove {{label}} and its drafts. Mail and calendar data stay with the provider.

switch.label: Allow agents to send and change things
switch.onNote: Agents can send mail and change your calendar only when a rule you approved allows it or you approve each action.
switch.offWarning: Off: every send, delete and calendar change is refused. Reading and drafting still work.

rules.intro: A rule lets agents send or change something without asking, only for exactly what it describes. Anything else still needs your approval.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.description: Without rules every send waits for your approval. That is the safe default.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this rule?
confirmDelete.description: Agents will need your approval again for what it allowed.

editor.title: Add rule
editor.noWildcards: Wildcards and public mail domains such as gmail.com are not accepted.
editor.template: The only text this rule may send
editor.freeWarning: I understand that free text can reveal information to the person being answered.
editor.dryRunHint: Check what this rule would do with an existing draft, without saving it.

errors.ack: Confirm that you understand the risk of free text.
errors.recipients: Add at least one address or domain.
errors.limits: Limits must be whole numbers of at least 1.

proposals.intro: Rules suggested by an agent or created from an approved message. Nothing here has any effect until you approve it.

empty.title: No proposals waiting
empty.description: When you approve a message and choose to propose a rule, it appears here.

audit.error: Could not load the audit trail

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.description: Every decision about sending or changing something is listed here.

help.google: Create an OAuth client of type Web application in the Google Cloud Console, enable the Gmail and Calendar APIs, and add your own account as a test user.
help.microsoft: Register an app in Microsoft Entra, add the redirect address below, and use its application (client) id.
help.generic: Create an OAuth client with this provider and add the redirect address below.

result.title: Sign-in did not finish
result.denied: The sign-in was cancelled or refused.
result.state: The sign-in request expired or did not start from this browser. Try again.
result.no_refresh_token: The provider did not allow lasting access. Remove this app from your account's security page, then sign in again.
result.failed: The sign-in failed. Check the client id and secret, then try again.

reconnect.generic: This account needs to sign in again.

approval.loadFailed: The message to be sent could not be loaded. Do not approve it.
approval.subject: Subject
approval.notInThread: A recipient has not written in this conversation.
approval.notAReply: This is not a verified reply to an existing message.
approval.ruleProposedHint: It is waiting for your review in Mail and Calendar. It is not active yet.
approval.ruleProposeFailed: The message was approved, but the rule could not be proposed
